verses.en: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, não me repreendas na tua ira, nem me castigues no teu furor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David. To keep in memory.> O Lord, be not bitter with me in your wrath; let not your hand be on me in the heat of your passion.

verses.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.pt: Porque as tuas flechas se cravaram em mim, e sobre mim a tua mão pesou.
verses.en_web: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
verses.en_bbe: For your arrows have gone into my flesh, and I am crushed under the weight of your hand.

verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.pt: Não há coisa sã na minha carne, por causa da tua cólera; nem há saúde nos meus ossos, por causa do meu pecado.
verses.en_web: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
verses.en_bbe: My flesh is wasted because of your wrath; and there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.

verses.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.pt: Pois já as minhas iniqüidades submergem a minha cabeça; como carga pesada excedem as minhas forças.
verses.en_web: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
verses.en_bbe: For my crimes have gone over my head; they are like a great weight which is more than my strength.

verses.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.pt: As minhas chagas se tornam fétidas e purulentas, por causa da minha loucura.
verses.en_web: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.
verses.en_bbe: My wounds are poisoned and evil-smelling, because of my foolish behaviour.

verses.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.pt: Estou encurvado, estou muito abatido, ando lamentando o dia todo.
verses.en_web: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
verses.en_bbe: I am troubled, I am made low; I go weeping all the day.

verses.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.pt: Pois os meus lombos estão cheios de ardor, e não há coisa sã na minha carne.
verses.en_web: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.en_bbe: For my body is full of burning; all my flesh is unhealthy.

verses.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.pt: Estou gasto e muito esmagado; dou rugidos por causa do desassossego do meu coração.
verses.en_web: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
verses.en_bbe: I am feeble and crushed down; I gave a cry like a lion because of the grief in my heart.

verses.en: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.pt: Senhor, diante de ti está todo o meu desejo, e o meu suspirar não te é oculto.
verses.en_web: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, all my desire is before you; my sorrow is not kept secret from you.

verses.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.pt: O meu coração está agitado; a minha força me falta; quanto à luz dos meus olhos, até essa me deixou.
verses.en_web: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
verses.en_bbe: My heart goes out in pain, my strength is wasting away; as for the light of my eyes, it is gone from me.

verses.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.pt: Os meus amigos e os meus companheiros afastaram-se da minha chaga; e os meus parentes se põem à distância.
verses.en_web: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
verses.en_bbe: My lovers and my friends keep away from my disease; my relations keep far away.

verses.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.pt: Também os que buscam a minha vida me armam laços, e os que procuram o meu mal dizem coisas perniciosas,
verses.en_web: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have a desire to take my life put nets for me; those who are designing my destruction say evil things against me, all the day their minds are full of deceit.

verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.pt: Mas eu, como um surdo, não ouço; e sou qual um mudo que não abre a boca.
verses.en_web: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: But I kept my ears shut like a man without hearing; like a man without a voice, never opening his mouth.

verses.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.pt: Assim eu sou como homem que não ouve, e em cuja boca há com que replicar.
verses.en_web: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.en_bbe: So I was like a man whose ears are shut, and in whose mouth there are no sharp words.

verses.en: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.pt: Mas por ti, Senhor, espero; tu, Senhor meu Deus, responderás.
verses.en_web: For in you, Yahweh, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.
verses.en_bbe: In you, O Lord, is my hope: you will give me an answer, O Lord, my God.

verses.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.pt: Rogo, pois: Ouve-me, para que eles não se regozijem sobre mim e não se engrandeçam contra mim quando resvala o meu pé.
verses.en_web: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
verses.en_bbe: I said, Let them not be glad over me; when my foot is moved, let them not be lifted up with pride against me.

verses.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.pt: Pois estou prestes a tropeçar; a minha dor está sempre comigo.
verses.en_web: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
verses.en_bbe: My feet are near to falling, and my sorrow is ever before me.

verses.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.pt: Confesso a minha iniqüidade; entristeço-me por causa do meu pecado.
verses.en_web: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.en_bbe: I will make clear my wrongdoing, with sorrow in my heart for my sin.

verses.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.pt: Mas os meus inimigos são cheios de vida e são fortes, e muitos são os que sem causa me odeiam.
verses.en_web: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
verses.en_bbe: But they are strong who have hate for me without cause: those who are against me falsely are increased in numbers.

verses.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.pt: Os que tornam o mal pelo bem são meus adversários, porque eu sigo o que é bom.
verses.en_web: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
verses.en_bbe: They give me back evil for good; they are my haters because I go after the thing which is right.

verses.en: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.pt: Não me desampares, ó Senhor; Deus meu, não te alongues de mim.
verses.en_web: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give me up, O Lord; O my God, be near to me.

verses.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.pt: Apressa-te em meu auxílio, Senhor, minha salvação.
verses.en_web: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
verses.en_bbe: Come quickly to give me help, O Lord, my salvation.
